title: Survival: First Life
description: A Vanilla+ Modpack for a more expansive adventure world with over 300 new vanilla-styled structures
body:
![a Blue large Text saying "Survival" and a slightly smaller set of text in green saying "First life"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e78a9053e49406e000fe6a01345a35f5758ab1df.png)

# The Basic Information
This modpack is meant to be a Vanila+ Modpack, Featuring over 100 Vanilla Styled (and Fantasy) Structures in every dimension!

## Minimum Specs for Modpack

<details>
<summary>Minimum</summary>

1. Radeon(TM) RX 460 Graphics (GPU)
2. AMD A10-5800K APU (CPU)
3. 2gb DDR3 (RAM)
 
This is the lowest grade PC i had to test it and it ran fairly well with only occasional lag spikes when moving around chunks when using LOWEST settings
</details>

## Details in the Shmetails
There are several amazing 'Quality of Life' mods in this pack, With a few well known ones like;

<details>
<summary>Featured QoL Mod list</summary>
  
1. Trinket Mods !(Charm of Undying & Elytra Slot)
2. Meow (Press G to Meow)
3. Entity Culling
4. Controller Compatiblity! (MidnightControls)
5. Just Enough Items (JEI)
6. Right Click Harvest & Mouse Tweaks
7. Wooled Boots
8. You're in Grave Danger (A Grave mod so if you die, it becomes a grave)
9. Natures/Structures Compass
10. Tax Free Levels
</details>

We also feature a list of mods that make the game feel more smooth! 
<details>
<summary>List of Smoothing Mods</summary>

1. Advancement Plaques - This mod makes it so a smooth bar comes to the top of your screen, Making it not as ugly and more smooth then the original Advancement Toast
2. BetterGrassify - It takes the Optifines Fancy/Fast Grass and puts it into Fabric
3. Chat Animation [Smooth Chat] - Improves chat visuals by adding smooth animations.
4. Explosive Enhancement - A better Explosion animation that makes the game feel more immersive and smooth
5. Dynamic Lights - A mod that makes lighting move around even when not placed as long as it is in your hands
</details>

This modpack also has a lot of structures mods!

<details>
<summary>Featured Structure Mods</summary>

1. Additional Structures (by XxRexRaptorxX)
2. MES - Moog's End Structures (by FinnSetchell)
3. MNS - Moog's Nether Structures (by FinnSetchell)
4. MVS - Moog's Voyager Structures (by FinnSetchel)
5. Moog's Structure Lib (by FinnSetchel)

</details>



There are a lot of other mods that are fairly smaller but this is an expansive modpack for adventuring

_Please note that this pack has the Travelers Backpack Mod by Tiviacz1337_

_Please also note that Singleplayer is the only confirmed & tested version that the modpack works, But we do know you CANNOT join Vanilla servers with this modpack_
